question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **process**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"process"** means a series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end. (प्रक्रिया)

 
 
• **Example: **The process of applying for a visa can be quite complicated.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 is **'process'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **process**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Guess **(अनुमान): An estimate or conclusion formed without sufficient information.

 
 
• **Example:** I can only guess how long it will take to finish the project.
 
 
 
• **Chaos **(अराजकता): Complete disorder and confusion.
 
 
• **Example: **The sudden power outage caused chaos in the building.
 
 
 
• **Area **(क्षेत्र): A region or part of a town, a country, or the world.
 
 
• **Example:** This area is known for its beautiful parks and gardens.
